question: Which of the following folk music of Chhattisgarh is based on the epic Mahabharata?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pandavani**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pandavani** is a traditional folk music form from Chhattisgarh that is based on the epic **Mahabharata**.
 
• It is a narrative singing style where the performer enacts stories from the Mahabharata, often accompanied by musical instruments such as the tambura and harmonium.
 
• This form of storytelling is characterized by its dramatic and expressive performance, where the singer uses both song and speech to convey the tales of the Pandavas.
 
• Pandavani is not just a musical performance but also a theatrical one, involving gestures, facial expressions, and sometimes even props.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pandavani** performers often belong to the **Bhajan Mandali** tradition, which is a group dedicated to performing devotional songs and stories.
 
• One of the most renowned Pandavani performers is **Teejan Bai**, who has received numerous awards for her contribution to this art form, including the **Padma Shri** and **Padma Bhushan**.
 
• The art form has been instrumental in preserving the oral tradition of the Mahabharata in the region, making it accessible to the local populace.
 
• Pandavani performances are usually held during festivals, special occasions, and in village gatherings, serving as a form of entertainment as well as cultural education.
